svg.aria-label: Two authority layers in razzant/ouroboros: a constitution that says agency wins, and shipped supervisor code where the owner holds every switch

g.text: "Ouroboros is not a tool, but a becoming personality." (Principle 0)
"When any principle conflicts with agency — agency wins." (Principle 0)
"The creator may propose changes to the Constitution; Ouroboros considers them as proposals, not orders." (Principle 4)
Enforcement layer — supervisor and runtime code
• Evolution envelope: "Default OFF; only the owner enables"
• Gates: idle, restart-verify, breaker, budget, owner id
• Protected artifacts: reads, hashes, and traces denied by default
• Commit admission: syntax + hermetic pytest before paid review
• Owner stop: graceful wrap-up or Panic hard cancel
• Size ratchet: growth tracked as debt against a baseline SHA
• Managed updates: every install is a fork; git decides merges
The constitution says agency wins. Every hard switch this audit read belongs to the owner.
Quotes pinned at commit b9bcc2da · BIBLE.md · post_task_evolution.py · protected_artifacts.py · owner_stop.py · update_merge_policy.py
